name: Input Stage
description: Receives canonical graph from Agent 01 and optional existing graph baseline

name: Merge Stage
description: Compares new canonical graph with existing baseline and resolves conflicts

name: Output Stage
description: Emits merged canonical graph with conflict annotations to orchestrator

name: Graph Fetcher
description: Retrieves new canonical graph from Agent 01 state and optional existing baseline graph from storage

name: Graph Differ
description: Analyzes differences between new and existing graphs; identifies entity additions modifications and conflicts

name: LLM Prompt Handler
description: Constructs Agent 02 system prompt (non-destructive merge rules) and user prompt (both graphs and detected conflicts); calls LLM

name: Merge Engine
description: Executes non-destructive merge logic preserving approved entities and attaching merge-conflict notes for analyst review

name: Validation Engine
description: Validates merged graph against canonical schema; ensures all IDs remain stable for unchanged entities; rejects if schema violated

name: State Emitter
description: Serializes merged canonical graph with conflict metadata; returns to orchestrator for Agent 03
